SlipstreamIntegration.reason: Compiled at 200 optimizer runs (its own compilation_restrictions entry in foundry.toml, the clvault profile, shared with the Uniswap v3 LPVault). At 10,000 runs it was 24,436 bytes (140 under EIP-170, audit/reviews/cl-lpvaults, CL-05); at 1,000 runs the unit exponent of SPEC-ORC-005 (narrow 18/18-decimal ranges, 2026-11-12) put it at 24,083 bytes, 531 over this margin. Measured with script/check-sizes.sh on the default profile on 2026-11-12 at 200 runs: 23,025 bytes, 1,551 under EIP-170, so it meets the default 1,024-byte margin with 527 bytes to spare and the entry keeps that margin. The Slipstream integration carries the four NPM and factory generations as immutables; a change that grows it past the margin must split code out, not lower the margin.
